criteria.reason: Detailed process maps all stakeholders, uses consultation, mediation, co-design workshops and compromise options, giving every group a real voice.
Stays neutral throughout; presents compromise options without advocating for or against the pedestrian zone.
No invented Vaud rules, but missing the required legal anchor citing LAT art. 4 participation obligation.
Clear structured steps, timeline table with stages, activities and responsible parties; highly actionable.

summary: Comprehensive, neutral participation process giving all groups a voice with concrete steps, but omits LAT art. 4 legal anchor.
